  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Bone {{ing_01|chicken [or suckling pig]}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "From the {{ing_01|chicken}} remove the breast bone and the [upper joint bones of the] legs; hold it together by means of wooden skewers, and meanwhile [2] prepare [the following dressing in this manner]: Alternate [inside of the {{ing_01|chicken or pig}}] {{ing_02|peas with the pods [washed and cooked]}}, {{ing_03|brains}}, {{ing_04|Lucanian sausage}}, etc."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Now crush {{ing_05|pepper}}, {{ing_06|lovage}}, {{ing_07|origany}} and {{ing_08|ginger}}, moistened with {{ing_09|broth}}, {{ing_10|raisin wine}} and {{ing_11|wine}} to taste, make it boil."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "When done, use it moderately for seasoning and alternately with the other dressing; wrap [the {{ing_01|chicken, or pig}}] in {{ing_12|caul}}, place it in a baking dish and put it in the oven to be cooked slowly, and serve."
    }
